item.description: Exporters welcome end in sight for Brexit checks – but are frustrated that implementation will take so long British producers have broadly welcomed the UK’s deal with the EU, designed to remove the vast majority of physical checks on food, plants and animal products. item.title: Phoenix man's 2015 deed had wrong address; court upheld invalidation of rival deeds
item.description: A property dispute arose in Phoenix, Arizona, due to a mistake in a property's street address. Robert Olsen received a quitclaim deed from his father, which included incorrect address details but correct property descriptions. Bonitas Casitas LLC later claimed ownership and filed a lawsuit, leading to competing claims over the property. The Arizona Court of Appeals upheld the lower court's ruling, reaffirming the validity of Olsen's original deed. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Chef Jose Andres rescues Baltimore's 45-year-old Thanksgiving food tradition
item.description: Cynthia Brooks' efforts to continue her mother Bea Gaddy's 45-year-old Thanksgiving food tradition in Baltimore faced a setback after donations fell short, leaving her with only eight turkeys days before the event. Celebrity chef Jose Andres World Central Kitchen and the Maryland Department of Public Safety and Correctional Services stepped in with food and resources, helping save the annual dinner that began in 1981. This initiative has blossomed into a cherished family and community effort, reinforcing the values of kindness and remembrance associated with her mother's legacy during the holidays. Gadsby’s granddaughter later cherished the lock alongside a portrait of the first president, making it a remarkable piece of history. Notably, Washington's hair has previously commanded prices nearing $40,000 at auctions, alongside other treasured memorabilia. Publicado también por: BBC News - World. item.description: Para que no se sobrecalienten los tres reactores fundidos de Fukushima y mantenerlos a una temperatura estable, entre 29 y 35 grados, deben ser regados constantemente. Cada día, los operarios de la compañía eléctrica Tepco inyectan 34 toneladas de agua en el reactor 1; 36 en el 2 y 65 en el número 3. En total, suman 135 toneladas diarias de agua que se contaminan al enfriar el magma radiactivo formado por los núcleos derretidos de los reactores y los escombros que dejaron las explosiones de hidrógeno que sufrieron tras el tsunami de 2011 , durante aquellos tenebrosos días de marzo en los que… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.

Con gestos dificultosos y sudando a chorros bajo sus monos especiales de plástico, pululan bajo grúas rojas, chimeneas de hierro blancas y cubiertas grises de acero y hormigón que envuelven los reactores , cuya silueta se perfila frente al azul intenso del océano Pacífico.
